newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals ranged ahead of Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals ranged ahead of Hindu festival.

text.p: Base metals held steady in a narrow price band on the metal market on Thursday, dealers said.

"Industrial buying remained low but restricted arrivals of the imported metals kept market quiet," one dealer said. "Trading volume was low due to poor attendance in the market as major players are out of town enjoying Diwali holidays."

Ready copper was steady at 11,550 rupees per quintal as was zinc at 6,250 rupees and lead at 4,650 rupees per quintal respectively. Tin was available at previous level of 34,900 per quintal and nickel at 37,200 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading. Aluminium was quiet at 7,200 rupees per quintal.
Overall sentiment remained subdued at the close and traders were expecting prices to move in narrow range ahead of Diwali.
